hero.title: Karim Boudabous
hero.subtitle: Sports Science & Elite Performance
hero.tagline: Training smarter. Performing better. Living stronger.
hero.badge: NSCA CSCS® · Strength & Conditioning Coach · MSc S&C

academic.title: Academic Foundation
academic.body: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Sport Sciences & Physical Activity from UCAM (Universidad Católica San Antonio de Murcia) and have already completed a Master's degree in High Performance Sport: Strength & Conditioning at the same institution. My academic training spans exercise physiology, biomechanics, sports nutrition, psychology, data analysis, and training methodology.

coaching.title: Coaching Philosophy
coaching.body: As a Football Coach (UEFA B), I believe elite performance is built on tactical intelligence, physical conditioning, and mental resilience. My methodology integrates sports science principles directly into training design — every drill has a purpose, every session has a measurable outcome. I apply long-term athlete development principles at every stage.

vision.title: Professional Vision
vision.body: My goal is to grow as a strength and conditioning coach, football coach, and personal trainer — applying evidence-based methods to help athletes and individuals reach their full potential. Currently pursuing the NSCA CSCS® certification and trained at Barça Innovation Hub, I am motivated to contribute to football clubs, performance centers, and fitness environments where long-term development and excellence go hand in hand.

items.title: Personal Training
items.description: Individualized training programs designed to improve strength, conditioning, and overall health. Emphasis on safe exercise execution, progressive load management, and sustainable fitness habits for long-term results.

items.title: Football Coaching
items.description: Football Coach (UEFA B) methodology applied to youth and team development. Technical, tactical, and physical training fully integrated, with a strong focus on long-term athlete development and player-centered coaching.

items.title: Strength & Conditioning
items.description: Evidence-based S&C programs focused on age-appropriate conditioning, injury prevention, load management, and athletic development — aligned with training and match demands. Currently pursuing NSCA CSCS® certification.
